description: Source code for a QR Code generator library, implementing QR code encoding, drawing, masking, and error correction.

classes.name: QrCode
classes.description: Class representing a QR code, including encoding, drawing, masking, and error correction functionalities.

classes.name: QrSegment
classes.description: Class for QR code data segments (used in encoding).

classes.name: ReedSolomonGenerator
classes.description: Class for generating Reed-Solomon error correction codewords.

methods.name: getFormatBits
methods.description: Returns format bits based on error correction level.

methods.name: encodeText
methods.description: Encodes text into a QR code with specified error correction level and minimum version.

methods.name: encodeBinary
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a QR code with specified error correction level.

methods.name: encodeSegments
methods.description: Encodes multiple data segments into a QR code with specified parameters.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the QR code version.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the QR code matrix.

methods.name: getErrorCorrectionLevel
methods.description: Returns the error correction level.

methods.name: getMask
methods.description: Returns the mask pattern used.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns whether a module at (x, y) is black.

methods.name: toSvgString
methods.description: Generates an SVG string representation of the QR code.

methods.name: drawFunctionPatterns
methods.description: Draws the function patterns (finder, alignment, timing) on the QR code.

methods.name: drawFormatBits
methods.description: Draws format information bits.

methods.name: drawVersion
methods.description: Draws version information bits.

methods.name: drawFinderPattern
methods.description: Draws a finder pattern at specified coordinates.

methods.name: drawAlignmentPattern
methods.description: Draws an alignment pattern at specified coordinates.

methods.name: setFunctionModule
methods.description: Sets a module as part of function patterns.

methods.name: module
methods.description: Checks if a module at (x, y) is black.

methods.name: appendErrorCorrection
methods.description: Calculates and appends error correction codewords to data.

methods.name: drawCodewords
methods.description: Places data codewords into the QR matrix.

methods.name: applyMask
methods.description: Applies a mask pattern to the QR code modules.

methods.name: handleConstructorMasking
methods.description: Selects the best mask pattern if not specified.

methods.name: getPenaltyScore
methods.description: Calculates the penalty score for the current QR code pattern.

methods.name: getAlignmentPatternPositions
methods.description: Returns positions for alignment patterns based on version.

methods.name: getNumRawDataModules
methods.description: Returns total number of raw data modules for a version.

methods.name: getNumDataCodewords
methods.description: Returns number of data codewords for a version and error correction level.

methods.name: ReedSolomonGenerator
methods.description: Generates Reed-Solomon error correction codewords.
